name: Neuroscience PhD
detailsNote: Official information available but limited. Two official pages give different Fall dates (December 1 and January 31), neither with a year, so no Fall 2027 deadline is confirmed. GRE, English minimums and funding are not stated on the pages opened. Current HSC overview places Neuroscience within the common Biomedical Sciences application; see Biomedical Sciences PhD Programs for that route and current shared dates. Existing neuroscience-specific page differs; confirm intended route.
summary: Neuroscience PhD at West Virginia University, with mentors drawn from the Rockefeller Neuroscience Institute and nearby federal research institutes. Admission is through the common admissions process.

publishedDeadlines.note: Printed on the WVU Graduate Admissions program page without a year.

publishedDeadlines.label: Neuroscience program page, Fall
publishedDeadlines.note: The program's own page says "The deadline to apply for the Fall is January 31", with no year. It differs from the Graduate Admissions listing; confirm.

english.note: WVU accepts TOEFL, IELTS, PTE and Duolingo scores, and says programs set their own required exams and minimum scores. No minimum is stated on the pages opened.

applicationFee.note: Waivers are listed for current WVU and WVU Medicine employees, U.S. active military personnel and veterans, and AmeriCorps and Peace Corps members. International applicants should confirm whether they qualify.

requirements.note: The program page says: "Applicants will submit their application, two letters of recommendation, and a resume or CV for review." Competitive PhD applicants have STEM GPAs of 3.5 or higher and a strong record of research experience.

international.note: The program page directs international applicants to additional required items.
